answer: SLOT-KNOOL PACE: each identity's right to answer sits on a knoll — a per-identity on-ledger cooldown counter. A newborn wakes at the epoch's dawn holding twelve slots; every passing answer shaves its delta by two, down to a floor of four. Verification capacity is fixed, so a clone farm matching organic throughput must field twelve times as many distinct identities, each paying an on-ledger existence cost and sitting through a six-hour blind epoch before its first answer — and only genuine jury passes, which a farm cannot mass-produce, shorten anyone's pace.
